findings.claim: Percent-encoded credential parameter names bypass the published-record credential guard.
findings.evidence: has_url_credentials only searches the original URL with a regex, while URL_PATTERN permits percent escapes. Consequently, https://example.org/a.tif?%74oken=abc passes these guards although its decoded query key is token. The generated JSON schemas repeat the same restriction, and fetch_range also uses this helper. Decode and inspect query parameter names, or reject encoded forms that cannot be validated consistently, and add regression cases.

findings.claim: The required three-argument read_product interface is unavailable.
findings.evidence: root is a required keyword-only parameter with no default. Calling read_product(product_id, local_files, metadata), as specified by AC4, fails with a missing-argument TypeError. The tests consistently supply root, including pipeline/tests/test_io.py:316, so they do not exercise the contracted call. Preserve that call by making root an optional override and test it without the override.
